scholarships.title: PMSS
points: The Post -Matric Scholarship Scheame (PMSS) is a Crucial Scheme Offering Financial aid to Students.
It Primarily Supports those from Scheduled Castes, Tribes, and Minority Communities.
The Scholarship is Awarded for Studies Starting  from the 11th standard onwards(post-matriculatoin).
Its Objectives is to Singnificantly increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio in Higher Education and Reduce Dropout Rates.

scholarships.title: 7.5 SCHEME
points: ​The 7.5% horizontal reservation quota was  introduced in Tamil Nadu to increase the representation of government school students.
​It is applicable for admissions into professional undergraduate courses, including Medicine, Engineering, and Law.
​The scheme targets students who have studied in State government schools from the 6th to 12th standard.
​The policy aims to provide preferential treatment to students from disadvantaged backgrounds, who often face barriers when competing with private school peers.

scholarships.title: LABOUR WELFARE SCHOLARSHIP
points: Educational assistance schemes are provided by Labour Welfare Boards (LWBs) for the children of registered workers.
​These scholarships generally cover financial aid for schooling (from 1st grade) up to undergraduate (UG) and professional courses.
​The schemes help to meet needs such as tuition fees, the purchase of books, and hostel charges.
​To avail of this scholarship, the worker must have been registered as an LWB member for a specified period (e.g., at least six months).

scholarships.title: ACHIEVERS SCHOLARSHIP
points: ​Our Education Service is delighted to announce a dedicated scholarship program for a select group of talented and deserving students.
​This initiative reflects our core commitment to fostering academic excellence and supporting the next generation of leaders.
​The financial aid provided will help recipients cover essential tuition and academic expenses for their current course of study.
​We are investing in education to ensure that potential is recognized and empowered, regardless of economic background.

scholarships.title: GOVERNMENT SCHOLARSHIPS
points: Government Scholarship Services: We assist you in applying for all types of scholarship schemes offered by the Central and State Governments to cover your educational expenses.
​Comprehensive Guidance: We provide clear guidance at every stage, from verifying eligibility to the successful submission of your scholarship application.
​Scheme Selection Expertise: Our expert team helps you select the precise government scheme that matches your academic background and eligibility criteria.
​Fulfill Your Educational Dreams: Easily access the benefits of government scholarships with our accurate assistance and effortlessly achieve your educational dreams.

scholarships.title: FIRST GRADUCATE
points: First Achiever of the Family: Create a new history by becoming the First Graduate in your family—the door to achievement is now wide open.
​Government Incentives: We clarify all the opportunities available to you, including special reservation and scholarships designed for First Graduates.
​No Barriers: Financial hurdles will not stop your educational dreams. We assist you in obtaining complete financial support to ensure your success.
​Your Success, Our Goal: We are ready to provide complete consultation, from eligibility verification to application submission, throughout your crucial academic journey.
